eventContext: UNRESOLVED: school, event name/date/stage and applicable update set

decision.reason: Transparent teaching-scope heuristic: bounded scope favors the narrower task; expanded scope evaluates broader capability. This is not measured optimization.

opportunities.text: FUEL contributes points while the HUB is active; TOWER tasks offer another scoring path. Availability depends on match phase and AUTO outcome.

rules.fact: AUTO lasts 20 seconds; TELEOP includes transition, alternating alliance shifts and end game.
Inactive-HUB FUEL earns no points; availability alternates based on AUTO/FMS outcome.

assumptions.value: Active HUB state plus alignment valid
assumptions.kind: proposed conservative release policy; not an official pose/alignment rule or inventory rule
unverified usable service interval; not the full official phase duration
unverified task target; not a possession-rule limit

assumptions.value: A small buffer can deliver the desired pieces inside the usable active scoring window.

alternatives.name: Small buffered shooter
alternatives.tradeoff: Simpler indexing and bounded inventory; more collection cycles.
alternatives.capabilityBurden: Small buffer, predictable indexing and explicit scoring-window state

alternatives.name: Large hopper throughput
alternatives.tradeoff: More storage and burst capacity; jam, packaging and power costs.
alternatives.capabilityBurden: Burst storage/feed, recovery under load and jam/power characterization

alternatives.name: Tower-oriented role plus modest scoring
alternatives.tradeoff: Additional scoring role; climb load path and integration effort.
alternatives.capabilityBurden: Separate climb load path, retention and integration budget plus modest scoring

criteria: Hard constraints and safety first: fail any applicable rule or unresolved hazardous load path and do not advance hardware.
Compare expected successful contribution, cycle time, consistency, alliance fit and development effort using measurements; weights await school priorities.
Prefer bounded scope only provisionally when team resources, alliance role and prototype evidence are unknown. No fabricated weighted score.

capabilities.requirement: Cancel autonomous demand at 20 s; physical stopping distance remains unmeasured.
capabilities.acceptance: Desktop test crosses deadline; all modeled voltage/release requests cancel.

capabilities.requirement: Active HUB state plus alignment valid; loss of validity prevents release.
capabilities.acceptance: Inject invalid/unknown state while ready and assert no feed.
capabilities.evidence: SeasonCaseTest.gateLossStopsFeed; gate is injected, not a validated field sensor

capabilities.requirement: Keep external ACTIVE/INACTIVE/UNKNOWN state; hold feed on unknown/inactive state as a conservative strategy.
capabilities.acceptance: Measure task success over repeated representative trials and confirm field geometry, loads and guard conditions.
capabilities.evidence: OPEN: teaching plant does not validate this capability

capabilities.requirement: Average service rate at least 0.600 pieces/s over the assumed usable interval; at most 1.667 s per piece on average.
capabilities.acceptance: Demonstrate 6 successful deliveries in 10 s with acquisition, transit, alignment and recovery included where applicable.
capabilities.evidence: OPEN: arithmetic requirement, no measured throughput or match-score forecast

capabilities.requirement: Resolve electrical protection, physical retention, guarding, load paths and inspection requirements before hardware.
capabilities.acceptance: Document component-specific ratings, rule review, load/energy analysis and supervised physical checks.
capabilities.evidence: OPEN: no hardware or manufacturing approval

sensitivity.example: If the usable window falls from 10 s to 5 s while six pieces remain desired, required average feed rises from 0.6 to 1.2 pieces/s. Reassess buffer, recovery, power and jam requirements; do not merely double motor voltage.

numericAlternative.meaning: Half the usable time doubles required average service rate; feasibility is unresolved.

handoff.firstExperiment: Bounded feed/recovery fixture with measured cycle timing; do not infer launch success from flywheel speed.
handoff.decisionGate: Reviewer records a strategy decision and resolves event/resource assumptions before subsystem requirements are frozen. Draft code/CAD may explore alternatives without implying approval.

existingEvidence.cad: Native guarded sideplates created; 6.35 to 7 mm thickness edit, F3D/STEP reopen and numerical geometry/history checks passed 2026-11-16. Separate experiment; not a complete assembly.
limits: No fuel flight, bounce, scoring sensor or full-field model
No FMS parser, phase-clock synchronization or scoring-window arrival-time verification
No complete legality review or physical system verification.
